scope: Public synthetic sequential abstract interfaces; reviewed structural facts, not production transport

cases.source: Return x+y exactly. Algorithms are internal.
Return the records with active=true as a collection.
Return active records. Any permutation is permitted; callers must ignore order.

ordering.source_quote: Any permutation is permitted; callers must ignore order.

cases.source: Return a collection containing at most one record.
Return exactly one highest-scored record. Scores may repeat.
Return exactly one highest-scored record. An invariant guarantees unique scores.
The unit argument may be omitted.
Filter by price less than limit. Price may be null.
Filter by price less than limit; admitted calls have non-null prices.
New sensor readings default unit to C. Historical stored readings may lack unit; load them.
New readings default unit to C. All admitted historical readings contain unit.
Lowercase submitted names.
Lowercase submitted names and enforce uniqueness. Both A and a are admitted.
Normalize names and enforce uniqueness; the admitted domain is already lowercase.
The API admits invalid integer text at its validation boundary.
Return a submitted collection; duplicate entries are admitted.
Store a value and subsequently read it.
Move open records to closed. The API permits repeated invocation on closed records.
Move open records to closed; each record can be invoked only once.
Persist an update and emit a notification. Notification may fail after writing; subsequent reads are in scope.
Persist updates; all failures occur before any write.
Temporary collection order is internal; only an exact sum is returned.
An internal cache may be used; exact returned values and no-effects frame are fixed.
Respond within the declared deadline or emit timeout. Choice at the deadline is unresolved.
Repeated reads return object handles whose stable identity is meaningful; identity across reads is unresolved.
Emit events for committed updates; event ordering and duplication are observable and unresolved.
